notes.title: Glimmerpass Mines - Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/1cb6e293a85b8a178f969c8fb096c4ee2242d055.png[/img]
Welcome to Glimmerpass mines, a feature-packed expansion for Tower Walker with tons of new content added to the basegame. Every single class in the game got a major addition to a skill, talent or ability gained from unique equipment set bonuses. Protect the miners in a mining expedition, gather precious stones, plant void seeds in the ground and grow your own void garden with the help of the dark wizard Kanadios Sedicuus. Work for a new faction, Mainheim Trading Company and purchase upgrades with guardian bounty points that you get from killing bosses deep in the mines. Discover new items from harvesting unique void plants during the right season or festival. Uncover secrets in the dark void infested places beneath the world. Enjoy!

[h2]Stay awhile and grind![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/c6bba774bb4940efa9a9bf7b9e463f0f9497d9ff.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/7aae68a3e8c1dc62886ca0bf7b094e1658380695.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/51e2b9e8b691bab61bf076b655b909af0979fba1.png[/img]

[b]SPECIAL TOOLS[/b]
Use watering can to make the void plants grow faster and increase potency of void magic to affect value and potential loots. The rare watering can has the power to change current season or festival.

[b]HARVEST - Extract loot or sell plant[/b]
Choose to sell your void plant to the Manheim Trading Company for coins or harvest it yourself for special loot

[b]VOID SEASON AND FESTIVALS - 26 new rare events[/b]
Void season and void festival events affects current growth and the outcome of actions in the void garden like planting, watering and harvesting.

[b]UNLOCK SECRETS[/b]
The right combination of season, festival and seed type can cause rare mutations and other effects. This will affect drop chance for loots. For example "Moortus the Weaver (MOL)" festival causes 100% drop chance for the "Soultaker Weaver Armor Set" when harvesting a Void plant (MOL) in some cases.

[h3]LORE[/h3]
[b]Manheim Trading Company and the Dwarf King  [/b]
([i]Tower Walker lore - 100% written by a human mind in 2019[/i])
[i]In the second age the Abyss Queens powers grew beyond the borders of the abyss and expanded into another dimension called the void. There she encountered the ancient void god Molgor. By using the soul magic in the tower and with the help of the dark sorcerer Moortus she managed to open a massive portal that released Molgor into the world. In the ancient scrolls of Xarras it is told of a prophecy that the old void god will be awakened and consume all magic in the world. The human noble Renard Manheim, a selfmade man of action, a man full of purpose, the leader of the richest trading company in all of the lands found a part of this ancient scroll during one his travels along the trade routes to Stormholme. He became obsessed by the quest to awaken the void god and his only mission in life became to fulfill this ancient prophecy no matter the cost. After years of planning he managed to make a deal with the ruler of the underground dwarven empire beneath Glimmerpass mountains. He convinced the Dwarf King Godrin to send out a mining expedition to explore the deepest darkest caverns under the mountain with the promise of great power...[/i]

[h3]Legendary Armor sets (S+) for all classes[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/883e25a6ffd01e02c55e05ed85161e981dd34dfa.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/e2d61b9c8a1b5f5b01250542a51a8f277aff5804.png[/img][/url]
This expansion brings special unique set bonuses that unlocks new skills, abilities or talents for each class. For example Tyrant set Raider unlocks a special bonus when completing the set which gives a passive ability called [b]Raider[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/8ab95ef93e62aa436e7c69ecca6b2892aca2dd1a.png[/img]
[h3]Combat engine upgrade++[/h3]
Combat is now more fluid with many major improvements to character movement, attack and hit animations, projectiles, enemy tracking and crowd control effects.  This affects both range and melee combat for all classes and also combat pets.

We carefully read all discussions, gathering information about what you do and don't like in the current build of the game. Your feedback is very important to us.

notes.title: Glimmerpass mines coming soon!
notes.content:
Happy new year! Let's take a peek at the next major expansion to Tower Walker with a release date to be announced soon. Prepare your characters to enter the portal to Glimmerpass mines and delve deep into the underground caves to face the Void Lord Molgor. Stay awhile and grind!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/b3ec71ecedfb22da768d339b56feaa69294534fe.png[/img]

[h2]New horde-mode dungeon[/h2]
Those who have attuned to all the previous dungeons will now have access to a new special portal that goes deep underground into the dwarven empire of "Glimmerpass" and into the mines. This will be a different kind of late-game challenging dungeon where you slay hordes of enemies to reach the next phase. We have adjusted some gameplay elements and added a dungeon map. Additionally, we have introduced new precious materials to grind for crafting and a different type of S+ weapon enchanting with cap locked behind progression. This will be more challenging content with rewarding grind.

[h2]S+ Awakening weapon[/h2]
Use artifacts found deep in the mines to awaken S+ weapons and unlock new enchant bonuses

[h2]New faction[/h2]
Gokron merchant guild with a base of operations called "Heavenly haven" in the mines is a mystery

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/2098a4a8d9d703197da6bea183795635be8b6e68.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/3d343c28f5752471cc934929bca113a5d8c17675.jpg[/img][/url]
[h3]LORE[/h3]
[i]In the third age the Manheim Trading Company that controls most of the trade routes in the human kingdoms encountered a mysterious merchant race called the Gokron. First contact was made when a caravan was sent out from the gokron settlement of Loktororr in the desert southlands to travel all the way to the human capital of Stormholme and trade priceless artifacts found deep within the dwarven mines in the Glimmerpass mountains. The humans could not know that all trade goods that the gokrons offered was corrupted by abyss magic and spread to all corners of the world for a reason. The gokrons used ancient hidden pathways deep within the mountains for all their trading routes between the humans, elves and the dwarven kingdoms. This made them very rich. Rich enough to take control of all the goblin clans. The gokrons became the overlords of the goblins and ruled them for hundreds of years. The wizards of the tower always knew that the gokrons could not be trusted since they worshipped the Void Lord Molgor also known as the nightshade.[/i]

[h3]This is a free update?[/h3]
The expansion "Glimmerpass mines" will be free content that can be fully unlocked by playing the game.

As always, thank you all for your support and feedback. We wish you all a great year 2025!

The troll king desired to claim the old treasure of whitefrost in a temple controlled by the wizards. To execute this task he needed the guild of troll beastmasters to find an open path around the magical shields surrounding the temple. The beastmasters skill in training wild animals was famous in all the lands. Their guild was located at the green gate in a jungle on the border to Kintanu Islands. In this jungle there was five great wild beasts. The mighty Ashfang was the biggest of them all and the leader of the pack. The attempt to tame Ashfang and these great beasts was a struggle that went on for many years. The troll king was furious about the failure to tame these beasts. [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/c49a27a0345f95882150aa3189e7821ed3973cf4.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/a41e016b1ac1818eb6575a9ad32127ec9a0f277d.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]MOLGOR THE NIGHTSHADE AND THE GOKRON[/b]
[i]In the third age the Manheim Trading Company that controls most of the trade routes in the human kingdoms encountered a mysterious merchant race called the Gokron. First contact was made when a caravan was sent out from the gokron settlement of Loktororr in the desert southlands to travel all the way to the human capital of Stormholme and trade priceless artifacts found deep within the dwarven mines in the Glimmerpass mountains. The humans could not know that all trade goods that the gokrons offered was corrupted by abyss magic and spread to all corners of the world for a reason. The gokrons used ancient hidden pathways deep within the mountains for all their trading routes between the humans, elves and the dwarven kingdoms. This made them very rich. Rich enough to take control of all the goblin clans. The gokron became the overlords of the goblins and ruled them for hundreds of years. The wizards of the tower always knew that the gokrons could not be trusted since they worshipped the Void Lord Molgor also known as the nightshade. The legends tell the tale of how Molgor of the south made a dark pact with the Siren queen in the frozen northlands. Their offspring became the first gokron. Demonspawn of nightshade born of siren magic to seek out power and dominate the desert southlands.[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/910dbdaa0a47bde9fc061e5e9170dd7cd8e9be12.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/e18d2ee234d4c457c6db176e6d536bb658a6322d.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]THE NOGGIN AND THE WATERGOD[/b]
[i]The noggin was an ancient tribe that lived in treehouses in a forest with the most peculiar purple flora and fauna on the border between desert southlands and the zulmaris swamplands. In the first age an ancient evil called Culzhargg from the depths of the ocean invaded the forest and placed a powerful curse on the noggin. This curse would prevent any noggin from fishing in the waters close to their village. It was a disaster for the tribe. The noggin would starve to death without their fishing. The elder shaman Mukzorg, the oldest of all the noggin was sent out into the world to get help. In a tavern called Driftwood on the border to the human kingdom of Stormholme he found the blue wizard Leonardo of the scepter order and his companion Priestess Sora, the beautiful daughter of the elven king Eodas. Leonardo agreed to form a fellowship with the quest to defeat the ancient evil and help the noggin to remove the evil curse that was put on their fishing ground. This was the first time the wizards of the tower encountered the abyss demon known as the watergod Culzhargg in the depths of the ocean. After a heavy defeat in the battle of Zaatara the elven king Eodas agreed to let the noggin live in the forest of Aldora. As a token of friendship he ordered elven craftsmen to build treehouses for them. [/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/ff169203ca204a0fc04c88a1957086d6acb7feb5.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/b9ea859d6858b633df75115e92e2b03338247c4a.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]THE MAGIC WARS[/b]
[i]Leonardo the blue wizard. One of the most powerful sorcerers of the first age in the tower was broken and defeated at the battle of Zaatara. The abyss demon Culzhargg in the depths of the ocean found a way to curse the only thing Leonardo cared about. His elven companion Priestess Sora, the beautiful daughter of the elven king Eodas. The evil watergod was too strong even for an elven princess to resist. Powerful abyss magic twisted her mind. She turned against the fellowship and even her own father. Sora meant everything to Leonardo. He would give up his life for her. She was the only thing that gave him purpose to live. When the blue wizard realized that she was lost. When he saw her red glowing eyes and twisted mind and when he truly understood that all his power and beyond could not save her he was unable to act putting his magic staff on the ground. Culzhargg had won. The battle was over before it even began. The fellowship of the noggin had failed their quest. And the blue wizard was never to be seen again. The elven king Eodas turned his anger towards the wizards in the tower. His daughter was lost and it was all their fault. This was the beginning of the magic wars that would last a hundred years.[/i]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/25be7bb8510acc8a933ed460254167604bd07224.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/f2fedf366d880a31fa8bdbd5ddf5af3551be3f25.jpg[/img][/url]
[b]THE THUNDERGOD TYRANNOS[/b]
[i]In the second age the Abyss Queen and her powers grew beyond the abyss and expanded into another dimension called the void. In the void shadows she encountered two ancient voidspawns. Molgor the nightshade and Golgor the ulentor. Both massive gigantic void lords that feeds of dark energy in all dimensions. By using the soul magic in the tower and with the help of the most powerful wizard of that era, the relentless Soultaker Moortus she opened a massive portal and released both of these creatures into the world. The first one Molgor the nightshade wandered into the desert southlands and encountered the lizards. His first void offspring became the thundergod Tyrannos that would rule the lizard empire with his puppet high king Salaasar by his side for hundreds of years.[/i]

notes.title: Gardens of Riana Update releasing November 30th 2023!
notes.content:
Today we announce a new free major update "Gardens of Riana" that will be available on November 30th with tons of new content and expanded gameplay elements and features to the lategame. It is time to prepare all your characters to enter the magical gardens and face the Archdruid Draydiac.

[h2]Stay awhile and grind![/h2]
Since the release in february we have now launched 42 free updates in 9 months. It has been quite a journey and the game now has a strong foundation to further expand with tons of endgame content and expansions. We are sticking around, and hope you guys are ready to stick with us on this journey we call Tower Walker. We appreciate the support of the community!

"Gardens of Riana" is a level 90+ dungeon with normal,heroic and brutal mode. Level 90 will be required to start the attunement process and enter the instance. Recommended level for heroic mode (challenge hardmode) is level 120. Heroic and brutal mode drops very powerful items (Tempest amor sets and weapons for all classes). 

[h3]Lore[/h3]
"[i]Lord Taedmorden was cursed by the queen of the Abyss to remain in her gardens. The origin of the Taedmorden flower has been told by wizards for a hundred years. It is a legend about love and betrayal. About powerful magic and dark urges. It is the source to how Riana turned away from the light. To embrace the darkness. Archdruid Draydiac fought the queen of the Abyss with all his power to protect the temple in the gardens. The sanctuary for the druids had been standing in peace since the first age of magic. Now it lies in ruins. The abyss demons has corrupted the lifetree. Even the forest god Korganos has been defeated and enslaved by the Queen. Hidden behind a protective barrier lies the portal and magical gate to the ancient temple of the druids. A sanctuary for the most powerful elder wizards of the Scepter order. Well kept enchanted gardens with fragrant magical flowers, gorgeous trees and many bushes decorate the outside of the temple. A handful of waterfalls flow into various small rivers. Statues of ancient sorcerers, the founders of the order are lined up outside of the temple gates, serving as reminders of the past. Tall, wide windows are scattered generously around the walls of golden stone in seemingly perfect symmetry. A huge gate with large metal doors leading into the temple halls. The magic in this place is very strong.  [/i]" - From Loremasters journal

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/143f65fbd040def48499989c92cd0b05679fed91.png[/img]
[h1]Are you ready for Tower Walker? 
[/h1]
Your chance to play Tower Walker is right around the corner. There is now only 2 months left until this special game is arriving to Steam on [b]February 8th[/b]! 

From Raptor Claw Games in Sweden, the studio behind games like Dino Nest and Boxing School comes Tower Walker, a pure offline singleplayer MMO Grind Simulator. A fresh new type of auto-grinder inspired by classic MMORPGS and RTS games with indirect control over your hero.

[h3][i]"This new game is dripping with fresh features and content. The devteam are currently working around the clock to get the final build ready for release..."[/i][/h3]

[h2]THE BASECAMP[/h2]
From the basecamp which is located on the ground floor you can navigate and move up in the tower to floors that are available.  This is the "town hub" with merchant npcs, trainers, loremaster, inventory and shared stash.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/e30ce8e40b74c4321ff0945e85a4718aa730ff4f.jpg[/img]

Kill enemies in the tower to gain experience and loot such as crafting materials, gear, weapons and rings. To progress further up in the tower beyond the locked sections you need to use the artifact key called [b]"Soul Ring"[/b] There is many special areas for you to explore. To open secret doors you need [b]Skeleton Keys, Guest room keys or Treasure Room keys[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/d7b2fe5a4df507b71c798cef3700ee47dd7993b2.png[/img]

[h2]SOUL RING[/h2]
Gather souls to open gateways and progress up in the tower. The Soul Ring is an old ancient artifact that uses soul magic to open gateways within the tower.  Equip the soul ring on your character to be able to drain souls and feed the ring when killing enemies to transform the ring to a key. When the ring is fully stacked it will become "Empowered" and will now function as a key to a gateway or locked door within the tower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/1031f0b09fd8c67c8b00547dc88948c5ff0c556f.png[/img]

[h2]WORLDSAVE[/h2]
All discovered floors and unlocked gateways within the tower will always be saved to your world which means that the tower itself will always remain open to all your characters (even new created characters) forever.  All your created characters share the same "world save". If you find a good favourite grinding and farming spot for certain materials or leveling up it will always be there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/a6bcc9a74dc10f5ea7f5352835aea597bb54f566.png[/img]

[h2]CHARACTER CLASS[/h2]
There is 21 classes in Tower Walker. You choose one of the origin classes in the start and then along the journey you select subclass paths at certain milestone levels to become more unique. Every class has different weapons, equipment, masteries and combat behaviours. Some have AoE(Area of effect) attacks others only single-target attacks. All characters have basic stats that affects combat abilties. All these stats will increase when a character is leveling up.  Specific stats can benefit certain classes more then others. All starters classes in Tower Walker have a primary stat that will affect them the most. This is inspired by the most basic and classic MMO systems.[list][*] Warrior classes (Strength)  
[*] Rogue classes (Dexterity) 
[*] Mystic classes (Intellect)[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/b6cc0b3e34afc218846f38138238d0dc85b604d9.jpg[/img]

To unlock expertise masteries at the class trainer you need to reach certain levels. 
Many types of armor and weapons can have special grade requirements. D-grade to S-grade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/c8aa02814b72bbc2b5057cf4deb46b8169bc7f4e.jpg[/img]

[h2]ENCHANT SCROLLS[/h2]
Enchanting in Tower Walker is very powerful but can also be a risky business. It is inspired by oldschool MMORPGS and has no cap or limit to the maximum amount of improvement that can be done to an item. It also has a chance to fail so the item itself gets destroyed in the process. Enchanting an item does not only improve it but also make it more valuable to sell to the merchants. To enchant an item in Tower Walker you need to have certain magic scrolls. The item also need to be the correct Grade and match the requirements on the scroll.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/336aad24ece9472bd8d0fe7961d08dd5af609543.jpg[/img]

[b]Common enchant scrolls[/b] for armor, weapons and rings has a 60% chance to successfully enchant an item.  It also has a 40% chance to fail and the item will be destroyed and turned into crystals. In this case half the amount of crystals that the player would get from a pure disenchant. Crystals can be sold to merchants or used to craft materials or trade goods in the workshop.

[b]Blessed enchant scrolls[/b] for armor, weapons and rings has a 100% chance to successfully enchant an item.  This makes these scrolls very valueable and rare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42896979/2d87a3b6ab817ffd0fd8b47fa4a49f8dceb7e4cf.jpg[/img]

[h2]BOSS FIGHTS[/h2]
